summary: Hacon–Witaszek run two special fourfold MMPs in positive and mixed characteristic p > 5 (over a Q-factorial target with exceptional locus in the boundary, Theorem 1.1, and semistable over a DVR, Theorem 1.2), via section extension and pl-flips, and derive W O-rationality and dlt modifications for fourfolds and conditional lifting of threefold minimal models to characteristic zero. Complete (cc-442dc5): every numbered statement is an item, every missing item is routed exactly once, and eleven findings are recorded. Lemma 2.2's index clause (E1), the unrestricted Lemma 2.16 (E2) and the global form of Lemma 6.6 (E6) are false as printed, and the proof of Theorem 6.1(2b) has a gap (E7); the main MMP theorems are unaffected. Not formalised.

items.statement: For f:T→Spec A proper with A Noetherian local and L invertible, if the closed fibre is a scheme and L restricted to it is ample, then L is f-ample. This statement does not assume completeness, H² vanishing, flatness or surjectivity on Picard groups.

items.statement: Let T→Spec R be flat projective with integral three-dimensional special and generic fibres, R a DVR, and H a Q-Cartier divisor whose restriction H_s is nef and big. Then H_eta is nef and big. Replacing H_s by a numerically equivalent divisor has no effect on this conclusion.

items.name: A primitive section avoids the entire special fibre
items.statement: Let T be integral and flat projective over a Noetherian DVR R with integral special fibre S, and let L be invertible. If H⁰(T_eta,L_eta)≠0, then there exists a section of L whose nonzero effective Cartier zero divisor does not contain S, or the zero divisor if that section is nowhere vanishing.

items.name: Effective perturbations from numerical representatives
items.statement: In the projective lifting setting of Theorem6.1(2b), let f:X→Z be the prescribed flop contraction, H=f*H_Z for H_Z ample, and A the Q-Cartier strict transform of an ample divisor on its chosen flop. N¹_Q surjectivity supplies Q-Cartier representatives Hcal,Acal with Hcal|X≡H and Acal|X≡A. For m sufficiently large, some divisible multiple of mHcal+Acal has a section whose divisor does not contain X. Dividing by that multiple gives an effective Q-divisor Dcal with Dcal|X≡mH+A, hence Dcal is negative on the chosen flopping ray. This is a perturbation construction, not yet the full lifted-step theorem.
